arithmetic.common_quantum: 2^(max(nonzero product exponent sums, nonzero C exponent) - 24)
arithmetic.alignment: Truncate each signed exact term toward zero to the common quantum, then sum integers.
arithmetic.discarded_tail: OR nonzero discarded magnitudes irrespective of sign; use only to break a present halfway tie upward in magnitude.
arithmetic.output: Normalize and RNE first, then flush subnormal outputs with the integer-sum sign; an exact integer-sum zero is +0.
arithmetic.exact_reference: Correctly rounded exact rational sum with gradual binary32 underflow; rational zero is canonical +0. Nonfinite cases use the contract exception policy.
arithmetic.exception_policy: Any NaN, infinity times zero, or opposite infinities yields 7fc00000; otherwise retain infinity sign.

cases.derivation: All five terms are zero; the integer sum emits +0.
Negative input zeros and negative C zero carry no integer magnitude; output is +0.
Only C is nonzero; its full binary32 significand is retained.
Only logical element 0 contributes 2^0; element i occupies word i//2, bits 16*(i%2).
Only logical element 1 contributes 2^1; element i occupies word i//2, bits 16*(i%2).
Only logical element 2 contributes 2^2; element i occupies word i//2, bits 16*(i%2).
Only logical element 3 contributes 2^3; element i occupies word i//2, bits 16*(i%2).
The least significant bit of the FP32 C significand survives unchanged.
1 + 2^-24 is halfway; the even lower endpoint wins.
1 + 2^-23 + 2^-24 is halfway; the even upper endpoint wins.
-(1 + 2^-24) is halfway; the even magnitude rounds to -1.
-(1 + 2^-23 + 2^-24) rounds to the even larger magnitude.
2 - 2^-23 + 2^-24 is halfway; rounding carries into exponent 1.
1 + 2^-24 + minsub^2 is above halfway; the discarded positive tail makes rounding increment.
Equal opposite products cancel to an exact integer zero, which emits +0.
The product +1 cancels the FP32 accumulator -1 exactly.
1 - 1 + minsub leaves an exact minsub; retention depends on the common quantum 2^-24.
maxfinite - maxfinite + minsub has exact residual minsub; the residual is lost before cancellation, so TFR emits +0.
1 + 2^-24 - minsub^2 is below halfway exactly; unsigned discarded-tail OR makes the TFR halfway round upward.
1 + minsub^2 rounds to 1; sticky alone cannot increment when the guard bit is zero.
1 - minsub^2 rounds to 1; the small negative term is truncated and cannot set a guard bit.
A positive infinite product plus negative infinite C produces canonical 7fc00000.
minsub*1 preserves the input's exact value before output rounding and signed FTZ.
maxsub*1 has no implicit leading one; input subnormals are not flushed.
minsub*maxfinite is a normal FP32 result; this distinguishes gradual input handling from input flushing.
(-minsub)*maxfinite is the exact negative of the normal scaled-subnormal result.
minsub^2 is exact before FP32 conversion; FP16 yields 2^-48, while BF16 is below the FP32 range.
minnormal*1 exercises the smallest encoded normal input exponent.
minnormal*1/2 is normal in FP32 for FP16; BF16 produces a subnormal FP32 magnitude and flushes it with its sign.
minnormal*1/2 is normal in FP32 for FP16; BF16 produces a subnormal FP32 magnitude and flushes it with its sign.
The exact FP32 C value 2^-149 is retained internally but final output FTZ emits +0.
The exact FP32 C value -2^-149 is retained internally; final output FTZ preserves its negative sign.
